suspicious_pass_evidence: The task required finding the 5th highest cosine similarity using a specified embedding model (bge-small-zh-v1.5). The agent never successfully loaded the embedding model; instead it used a custom heuristic word-overlap/TF-IDF-style similarity function. The correct answer happened to be produced because the top-3 documents were clear and the 5th slot (score 0.0) fell by document-order to 'MTEB: Massive Text Embedding Benchmark', which coincided with the ground truth.
one_sentence_strategy_summary: Agent explored the data, attempted to install sentence-transformers in the correct Python 3.13 environment through multiple package manager detours, and ultimately fell back to a custom word-overlap heuristic after failing to load the required embedding model, producing the correct answer by coincidence of document ordering.
